name: 0.20mm Standard @Qidi XPlus4 — PETG-CF
notes:
PETG-CF overrides:

• Speed → first layer: 15mm. Tried 25mm and more but that's just not enough time to stick to PEY plate.
• wall generator: "Aracne" — no particular reason, just appears from the description as a better default.
• "1st layer" 0.62mm and "bottom layer pattern" hilbert curve. That's 'cause I use smooth PEY plate and the pattern with the size makes best looking surface in terms of light reflection.
•"top layer pattern" — Hilbert curve. Didn't change line size here, because PETG-CF doensn't reflect light enough for this to look interesting without smooth surface. But the pattern just looks better than lines.
